name: 20886 · Montgomry Vlg, MD
findings: ZIP 20886 (Montgomry Vlg) has 84 nonprofit organizations. 39 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 33 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 20886 (Montgomry Vlg) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
